mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to rent a scooter or moto in Bocas del Toro?

acceptedAnswer.text: At Flow Rentals, a Honda Navi is $30 for a full day or $25 for 4 hours after 2:00 PM. A scooter is $35 for a full day or $30 for 4 hours after 2:00 PM. An e-bike is a flat $20. Ask about special low-season pricing.

mainEntity.name: Do I need a license to rent an e-bike or moto in Bocas del Toro?

acceptedAnswer.text: No license is needed to rent an e-bike from Flow Rentals. For the Honda Navi or scooter, ask about license requirements when you book.
Flow Rentals is open every day from 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM on Isla Colón, Bocas del Toro.
Flow Rentals is on Calle Primera, Isla Colón, Bocas del Toro, Panama, right in front of the police station.

mainEntity.name: Does Flow Rentals deliver to hotels?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Flow Rentals offers hotel delivery and pickup on Isla Colón. Ask on WhatsApp when you book.

mainEntity.name: Is there a discount for renting in low season?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Flow Rentals offers special pricing during low season. Ask directly on WhatsApp for current rates.
